page_title: SwifDoo PDF – PDF Editor to Edit, Convert & Sign PDF Files

sources.entry: SwifDoo PDF - PDF editor/converter for editing, compressing, and password-protecting PDFs.

summary.name: SwifDoo PDF
summary.one_liner: SwifDoo PDF is a PDF editor and converter for Windows, Mac, iOS, Android and the web that edits, converts, OCRs, signs, protects and translates PDF files.
use_cases: edit text and images in a PDF
convert Office files or images to PDF
OCR a scanned PDF to make it searchable
translate selected words in a PDF
summary.what_it_does: The page describes editing text, images and links directly in PDFs, adding and filling forms, and using Find & Replace across a document. It converts PDFs to and from Office formats (.doc, .docx, .xlsx, .pptx, .rtf), images, and CAD files (.dwg, .dxf), and can create blank PDFs or scan paper into PDFs. It offers OCR to make image-only PDFs searchable and translation of selected text, plus an AI tool for summarizing and proofreading PDFs. Security features mentioned include two-level password protection, differentiated permissions, and electronic signatures.
notable: Office-like interface with edit, convert, OCR, and AI summarize tools
Lightweight install, stated at 30 MB disk space
Converts CAD (.dwg/.dxf) files to PDF and back
Two-level password protection with differentiated permissions
caveats: Page says some free downloads exist, but full feature sets and paid tiers are not detailed on the page
Some platform features are described as free only in marketing text; specific limits are not stated
